ANDARES.Passagem.FIELDS.tipo.label: Passage type
ANDARES.Passagem.FIELDS.tipo.hint: Stairs: the screen goes dark and footsteps play. Elevator and hole: transition only (no sound yet). Used by clicking the icon with the token next to it.
ANDARES.Passagem.FIELDS.destino.label: Destination level
ANDARES.Passagem.FIELDS.destino.hint: Automatic: the region's other level. With more than two levels, whoever passes chooses Up or Down.
ANDARES.Config.SomSubirDica: The footsteps heard going up (about 3 seconds).
ANDARES.Config.SomDescerDica: Footsteps going down. Empty = same as up.
ANDARES.Config.Mestre: The GM also sees the transition
ANDARES.Config.MestreDica: Off: when the GM drags a token through stairs, it changes level without the screen going dark.
ANDARES.Editar.SemAndares: This scene has no levels. Create the levels first.
ANDARES.Editar.ClicaOnde: Click where the stairs are. Esc to cancel.
ANDARES.Editar.AgoraOutroAndar: Stairs placed on {andar}. Switch to the other level and click where they arrive (or on existing stairs). Esc leaves them unlinked.
ANDARES.Editar.MudaDeAndar: Switch to the other level first.
ANDARES.Editar.FicouSozinha: The stairs are unlinked: they link automatically to stairs of the same type on another level, or right-click to link them.
ANDARES.Editar.LigadaA: Linked to {andar}. Drag the icon to move it.
ANDARES.Editar.NaoLigada: Not linked (goes to stairs of the same type on another level). Drag the icon to move it.
